notes: Right-panel Wire Credits and Leaderboard are now collapsible sections: click the header (chevron shows state) to expand/collapse, and both default to collapsed. The chat box changed from a fixed 420px height to flex-grow, so it fills whatever vertical space the collapsed sections free up, and grows past 420px on tall viewports even when the sections are expanded. Collapse state persists per section in localStorage (fm_wire_collapsed, fm_lb_collapsed). CLIENT-only change (client/index.html + client/style.css): hard-refresh only, no pm2 restart needed.
